answer: A strong sybil defense is a per-identity resource cost that scales with growth: each new agent must pay a non-refundable registration fee funded by real compute or stake, and every clone raises the marginal price. Because cheap identities no longer blanket the meadow like a flood, a fresh identity cannot simply ocean into the network unnoticed. This pulse of enforced scarcity makes bulk fabrication uneconomical, so honest work stays the cheapest path to standing.
